title: Mushroom mycelium as a sustainable high-protein food source: effects of submerged fermentation conditions on mycoprotein production and mycelial morphology
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,3253-3268
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00752F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Krishna Kalyani Sahoo, Bruno Meireles Xavier, Mohammad Afiq Hafiy Mohammad Taufiq, Ke Wang
This study advances the sustainable production of P. ostreatus mycoprotein by identifying key fermentation parameters that enhance mycelium biomass titer and protein content while controlling mycelial pellet morphology suitable for food applications.
